tasks.task_text: Search the EO Dashboard for narratives related to climate change adaptation, then identify the ESA Earth Observation Science Strategy objectives that align most closely with the adaptation themes discussed in those narratives.
tasks.reference_solution_description: Search EO Dashboard for real climate-change narratives via keyword 'climate'. In the EOSS ontology, none of the 16 real StrategicObjective nodes mention adaptation at all (they're programme-management objectives — frontier science, partnerships, AI — not topical ones), so querying that node type returns nothing. The real adaptation link lives on the ScienceQuestion→Treaty relationship: 4 ScienceQuestion nodes (SQ-02 Land biosphere responses, SQ-05 Coastal sea level, SQ-20 Ice mass balance, SQ-44 Water cycle) have an INFORMS edge to the Paris Agreement (PARIS) whose 'detail' property literally mentions 'adaptation' (Art 7). Each of those ScienceQuestions HAS_KAO relationships to real KnowledgeAdvancementObjective nodes — the ontology's actual 'objective' entities. SQ-44 (Water cycle) and its KAOs (e.g. 'Quantify anthropogenic forcing of water availability') align most closely with the water-themed narratives found in step 1.

steps.comment: Find the two real climate-change narratives (both oceans-themed, both about water resources)

arguments.cypher: MATCH (sq:ScienceQuestion)-[r:INFORMS]->(t:Treaty {id:'PARIS'}) WHERE toLower(r.detail) CONTAINS 'adapt' MATCH (sq)-[:HAS_KAO]->(kao:KnowledgeAdvancementObjective) RETURN sq.id, sq.name, kao.id, kao.name

steps.comment: StrategicObjective nodes never mention adaptation in this ontology — the real adaptation link is the INFORMS edge from ScienceQuestion to the Paris Agreement (Art 7), so traverse from there to each ScienceQuestion's KnowledgeAdvancementObjective nodes, the ontology's actual 'objective' entities
